verdict.rationale: Docs claim dynamic rules for group access and automatic provisioning/deprovisioning tied to role changes (rippling-it-docs-3, rippling-it-docs-18, rippling-it-docs-31), which supports rule-based group assignment replacing manual grants. However, there's no detailed evidence of actual dynamic group membership mechanics (e.g., attribute-based rule builder, group-based app assignment workflow specifics) or independent/hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: concrete documentation of dynamic group rule configuration UI/logic, evidence of group-based app assignment as distinct from individual role-based provisioning, independent corroboration of this working in practice.
